Wisdom +11: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +11 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Accuracy X: Passive: +10 Competence bonus to attack rolls
Mythic Goggle Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
